title: Power Rangers Season 7 Lost Galaxy
description: A group of youngsters set out on a space journey to Terra Venture in search of a new colony to live. Soon, empowered by mystical swords, they prepare themselves to fight evil space villains.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x1
episodes_data.description: An adventurous young man embarks on an epic adventure in space when he sneaks aboard the massive space colony Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x2
episodes_data.description: The Galaxy Rangers are born as five heroes unite to protect the planet Mirinoi from the villain Furio.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x3
episodes_data.description: The Rangers befriend the Galactabeasts - five enormous animals that help them defend Terra Venture from the forces of the evil Scorpius.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x4
episodes_data.description: Leo adjusts to his responsibilities as a member of the GSA when he forgets to properly lock a weapon storage room on Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x5
episodes_data.description: A homesick boy who misses Earth helps the Rangers during Furio's sleeping gas attack on Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x6
episodes_data.description: The shape-changing monster Mutantrum poses as Mike to lure Leo to the legendary Lights of Orion.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x7
episodes_data.description: Battling the Wisewizard, Kendrix meets an actress on a movie set who looks exactly like her.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x8
episodes_data.description: Kai is smitten by a pretty girl but has little time for romance as the Quake Maker monster attacks Terra Venture with Earthquakes.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x9
episodes_data.description: The heroic Magna Defender renews his feud with Scorpius' new general Treacheron.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x10
episodes_data.description: Seeking vengeance for his son, the Magna Defender battles the Fish Face monster on Terra Venture

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x11
episodes_data.description: Leo and the Magna Defender are forced to work together when the Chillyfish monster freezes the people of Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x12
episodes_data.description: Kendrix and Maya work to escape from a force field created by the monster Destruxo before he can find the Lights of Orion.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x13
episodes_data.description: It's a three-way race between the Power Rangers, the Magna Defender, and Destruxo as the Lights of Orion return.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x14
episodes_data.description: Treacheron turns on Trakeena as the Power Rangers must fight the Shark Brothers without Leo.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x15
episodes_data.description: The Magna Defender struggles to overcome his regrets of the past while protecting Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x16
episodes_data.description: Mike returns to Terra Venture and searches for a new role to fight against the Skelekron monster.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x17
episodes_data.description: After hearing from her monster that she isn't the prettiest girl in the world, Trakeena orders him to steal the beauty of all the attractive women of Terra Venture. After she tries to trick Mike, he understands what's been going on and destroys her monster, with the Rangers help. Meanwhile, Trakeena has scurried home, but her father has told her it's time for her to go through her full metamorphosis but she refuses and runs away making Scorpius angry.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x18
episodes_data.description: A rescue team led by Mike follows a distress call to an abandoned space ship. There they find a spider monster who captures most of the crew. Mike and Leo free the team, and retrieve a mysterious book, just before the ship explodes.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x19
episodes_data.description: The treacherous Deviot assists Scorpius by unleashing three lost Galactabeasts to attack Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x20
episodes_data.description: The Rangers struggle to free the lost Galactabeasts from Deviot.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x21
episodes_data.description: Trakeena escapes the planet Onyx, where she is trained by Villamax. Meanwhile, Deviot sets Scorpius up to be killed by the Rangers. When Trakeena hears of this, she races back to the Scorpion Stinger to assume command, just in time to prevent Deviot from using her coccoon.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x22
episodes_data.description: Trakeena captures Leo to make him pay for killing her father. The two fight one on one, until Deviot's hitmen try to kill Trakeena. She turns the tables on the assassins, and Leo escapes while the villains are distracted.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x23
episodes_data.description: One of Maya's old friends, Shondra, appears on Terra Venture. Kendrix's suspicions of her are proven to be true, when Maya finds Shondra stealing the Galaxy Book. Shondra reveals herself to be one of Trakeena's monster, and the Rangers destroy her and retrieve the book.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x24
episodes_data.description: Holding High Commander Renier hostage, Trakeena demands that Terra Venture send her a mechanic to fix the Scorpion Stinger. Damon volunteers, and while he works on the engine, Leo sneaks in and frees the Commander.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x25
episodes_data.description: One of Trakeena's monster takes control of Commander Stanton's mind, and has him set Terra Venture on a course towards a star. Only by disregarding the rules and following his instincts is Kai able to discover this plot, free Stanton, and save Terra Venture.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x26
episodes_data.description: Leo, Damon, and Kai race the Motor Mantis monster on motorcycles, the prize: Kendrix and Maya!

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x27
episodes_data.description: Deviot sends the honorable warrior Loyax to destroy the Rangers, but when he meets Maya he questions the honor in his ways.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x28
episodes_data.description: Leo struggles to earn the approval of the brother of the girl he wants to date while trying to save her from Trakeena's latest monster.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x29
episodes_data.description: The Rangers fight the Chameliac Warrior to save their Galactabeasts.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x30
episodes_data.description: Deviot enlists the Psycho Rangers to capture the Galaxy Rangers, prompting Andros and the Space Rangers to travel to Terra Venture to help.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x31
episodes_data.description: The Space Rangers and Galaxy Rangers unite to help Kendrix against the Pink Psycho Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x32
episodes_data.description: Karone once again assumes the role of Astronema as she risks her life to save the Pink Quasar Saber from falling into the hands of evil.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x33
episodes_data.description: Karone struggles to overcome her evil past as Astronema while adjusting to being the new Pink Galaxy Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x34
episodes_data.description: Damon competes for the position of chief mechanic. He is beaten by Baxter, who steals his plans to win. Baxter and Damon must then team up to defeat the Decibat monster, by using the machine Damon invented.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x35
episodes_data.description: The Guardian arrives on Terra Venture, to get the Galaxy Book back. Deviot interferes, and the Guardian is killed, passing on the role of guardian to Kai. Deviot gets the book, and transports Terra Venture into the lost galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x36
episodes_data.description: Terra Venture is greeted in the Lost Galaxy by Captain Mutiny, who the Rangers discover runs a slave camp, and is looking to add the colony's citizens to his work force. Mutiny unleashes the Grunchor monster on Terra Venture, which burrows underground.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x37
episodes_data.description: The Rangers race to find the Grunchor monster, who is causing massive earthquakes and destruction on the station. He surfaces at the command of Barbarax, and attacks the Rangers, who destroy him with fire.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x38
episodes_data.description: Leo and Damon are captured by Captain Mutiny and hung out to bake in the sun. As they roast, they remember their past adventure as Rangers. The others find them and set them free.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x39
episodes_data.description: Captain Mutiny's sorceress Hexuba uses her magic to cause the Power Rangers to fall into a deep restless sleep.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x40
episodes_data.description: Hexuba resurrects past monsters, and sends them down to Terra Venture. The Rangers wear themselves out battling monster after monster, but Kai travels to the source, a graveyard, and puts an end to Hexuba's voodoo.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x41
episodes_data.description: Captain Mutiny decides to unleash his most fearsome monster against the Rangers - the Titanisaur. The Rangers and their Megazords must combine all of their powers and give it all they've got to defeat this creature.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x42
episodes_data.description: Mike sacrifices to help Terra Venture escape the Lost Galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x43
episodes_data.description: Terra Venture discovers a lush green planet to colonize as Trakeena merges with Deviot to become stronger than ever.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x44
episodes_data.description: The Rangers work to evacuate the crew of Terra Venture as Trakeena launches her final assault.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy 7x45
episodes_data.description: Trapped on a desolate Moon in the ruins of Terra Venture, Leo faces Trakeena all alone.
